scope: Static import and document references, supplemented by reviewed dynamic ownership below; not a proof of no runtime dependency.

dynamic_ownership.packaging/BRACE.spec: Collects examples/templates/static directories and explicit docs; missing packaged docs fail release build.
dynamic_ownership.brace_app/server.py: StaticFiles exposes active static assets. API dispatch reads example paths and allowlisted exports.
dynamic_ownership.tools/audit_ui_strings.py: Recursively inventories Python/JS/HTML/JSON/CSS; generated ledger is regenerated, never discarded.
dynamic_ownership.scripts/seal_source.py: Seals non-runtime source paths; removal updates the manifest after review.
dynamic_ownership.scientific_example_directories: Preserved for runtime, regression and historical provenance; not deleted by filename heuristics.
